pokedexEntries.bk: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

pokedexEntries.wh: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

pokedexEntries.sw: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other’s strength.

pokedexEntries.sh: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon lives in nests that are made in the ground. People in ancient times used its tusks as cooking knives.

pokedexEntries.vi: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.
